material_findings.title: Codegeist 2026: Build with context. Ship with confidence.
material_findings.confidence: high for organizer rules, schedule and cash prize math; participant readiness unknown
material_findings.prize_evidence: Official rules: 3 x $15,000 first prizes, 3 x $8,000 second prizes, 3 x $5,000 third prizes = $84,000; four bonus categories with 6 x $1,500 each = $36,000; total $120,000 cash. One submission may win up to one grand and one bonus prize. Swag is noncash.
material_findings.eligibility: Adults at age of majority; teams and organizations allowed; listed exclusions include Brazil, Quebec, Belarus, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Sudan, Myanmar, sanctioned parties, promotion entities and judges.
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase or payment necessary. Free Devpost account and free Atlassian Cloud Developer License; actual hosting/usage expenses, if any, unverified.
material_findings.authorization: Competition authorizes original Forge app submissions only; no security testing of Atlassian or third-party services.
material_findings.requirements: Working Forge app integrated with Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Teamwork Graph or Rovo; judge-installable link, setup instructions, public YouTube demo under five minutes (judges may watch only three), description, relevant bonus writeup.
missing_verification: Confirm Devpost registration and entrant-specific eligibility.
Confirm Atlassian Cloud Developer License and Forge/Rovo/MCP module access and any quotas or hosting charges.
Prototype judge-installable Forge app using sanctioned test tenant, validate rights to all third-party dependencies.
Confirm submission video and installation-link access before deadline.
material_findings.next_action: Build/integration agent verify free Forge access and judge-installable app feasibility; select one narrow category and bonus; only then activate case.
